purpose: Not an analysis: the release of the series of v7s's captures (Release paragraph of paper B's manuscript; sections VII and VIII rest on v7s's captures and on v7u's reading of h_ms). For every item of v7s's runlogs, the kinds and times of the planned presses and of the presses recorded on the hook and on the page, as v7s's analysis reads them; for Firefox's page also the handler's time (h_ms), as v7u reads it. No value of v7s, v7t, v7u or v7v is computed again or changed.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-20, after v7s's, v7u's and v7v's records, before any capture is read for the release (the researcher's decision of 2026-11-20: the release includes v7s's series). Code: works/export_v7s_series.py, committed with this file. It runs v7s's loading unchanged (prototype_v7s at 5508490: read_runlogs, known_tables, read_series, check_one_firefox, with v7's load_all and H0 as v7s's main makes them) and records every capture v7s's load_item returns; Firefox's page at the handler's time is v7u's page_at_handler (prototype_v7u at ba4bfc8, prototype_v7t at 502f31e). The code checks those bytes and v7s's runlogs against v7s's record before anything is written. Amended before any capture was read, after the code review (Claude and Codex, 2026-11-20): the files read on the way to H0 and the environment (src/keystroke.py, prototype_v4, prototype_v5, the conditions of v7 and v6, pyproject.toml, uv.lock) checked against 5508490 and every module checked to have been loaded from its checked file; the structure checked beside the cells (exactly the release's files, each unit once, each layer's i = 0, 1, ... from a first time and h_ms of 0, the layers a unit has as its status allows); the counts checked against v7s's record on the work PC before writing; the manifest's keys and forms checked; tests for each. Not checked: the bytes of each capture file against those v7s read (v7s's record holds no per-file hash; the runlogs and runs.json are checked).

series.not_in_v7s: M3 (v7s's groups are K_chrome, MC_chrome, F_K, F_M0, F_M2, F_H1: no M3 item was planned or typed)

licences.kupa_derived: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, with attribution to KUPA-KEYS (Hugging Face ALTACambridge/KUPA-KEYS; LREC-COLING 2024) and a statement of how the series were made: F_H1's plans are the first 10 of v7's H persons' key-down times (H0) with the keys replaced by their kinds, typed in Firefox
licences.not_kupa_derived: CC BY 4.0 (known gaps: constant gaps; MC: M0's kinds at a constant gap; F_M0 and F_M2: v7's M0 and M2 plans, made by the first author's rules and the LLMs, not from KUPA)

content.layers: plan (events.ndjson), hook (hook.ndjson; absent for K_chrome_nohook and F_K_nohook) and page (page.ndjson), as v7s's load_item reads them with v7's readers: counted kinds only (alnum, space, end, enter, backspace, delete, other), auto-repeats left out, in capture order, times in ms from the layer's first counted press, not sorted and with equal times kept (no cleaning)
content.rows: one CSV per series, columns series, unit, layer, i, kind, t_ms, h_ms; t_ms written with 6 decimals (the page's event.timeStamp as v7s reads it, the hook's time, the plan's time); h_ms only on the page rows of Firefox's series: the handler's performance.now() from the first counted press, as v7u's page_at_handler gives it, 6 decimals; empty on every other row
content.units: the unit part of v7s's item names: c000.. (a known gap's ms), t00.. (the text index of v7's M0 and M2; text t is prompt P(t+1)), h00.. (F_H1: the index of v7's H persons in the draw order, the same index as v7's H1_idle). No KUPA identifier
content.status: status.csv: series, unit, status (captured / failed / no_plan), redone (true or false), plan (yes / no). One row per item of v7s's runlogs (the runlogs hold exactly the items v7s's plan makes, a check of read_series), and for MC, F_M0, F_M2 and F_H1 one row per unit as read_series counts them: a text v7 had no plan for is no item there and is a no_plan row (so that the counts are those of v7s's record). A no_plan unit has no row in the series file
content.manifest: manifest.json: per file its SHA-256, rows and presses per layer; provenance (run time, HEAD, dirty, conditions and code SHA-256, v7s's runlogs' SHA-256 and v7s's record's SHA-256)

never_written: keys or characters of any plan (Plan.keys), text, prompts, KUPA identifiers or KUPA's keys (read only to make H0 as v7s does), meta.json, runlogs, browser versions, inject or LLM files, v7's captures (read only for v7s's checks: they are released by export_v7_series)
check_on_the_work_pc: Before writing, the code checks every cell against an allow-list (series names of the release, unit names of v7s's items for that series, layers, integers, the counted kinds, times of the 6-decimal form, h_ms only on a Firefox page row) and stops on any other cell; tests place a 60-character string, a key name, an identifier-like unit, a series under the wrong licence, and an h_ms on a Chrome row in copies and see each stopped. Before writing, also on the work PC: for MC, F_M0, F_M2 and F_H1 the units per status against v7s's record's counts (sessions, captured, failed, no_plan); for the known gaps (not in the record's counts) each item's status against the record's path measures (an entry with measures where captured, {'status': ...} elsewhere). After the return, on the Mac: the files' SHA-256 against the manifest, the same allow-list and structure checks read again, and the same counts.
output: results/export_v7s_series/ on the work PC: kupa-derived/F_H1.csv, not-kupa-derived/<series>.csv, status.csv, manifest.json. The run refuses to write if the folder exists.
